methodology.timing: perf_counter around GNU time spawn/wait4; GNU time reports target-child CPU and Linux peak RSS, excluding Python pre-exec fork high-water mark
methodology.correctness: exact names, percentage strings, full byte totals and file sets against actual Ruby, plus full source hash verification
methodology.flat_oracle: Ruby committed tree with identical blob content and root attributes; no Ruby flat-directory support assumed
methodology.size_caveat: source bytes are fully written and hashed before scanning; profilers may read only classification prefixes. Logical bytes per second is not physical disk throughput.
